topic: A Pen-Cap Hole Is an Airway Safety Feature

Packaging claim: The Pen-Cap Hole Has an Airway Safety Job
Core fact: BIC says its vented pen caps comply with ISO 11540, a safety standard intended to reduce the risk from accidental inhalation of pen caps.
Second reveal: The same vent also allows more air circulation around the pen point when capped, according to BIC.
First-frame and mechanism illustration: Close view of the hole in a familiar BIC-style pen cap, then a simple nonliteral airflow illustration through the vent. Do not imply the animation demonstrates safe breathing or swallowing.
Fact boundaries: Do not say the hole makes swallowing safe or guarantees breathing. Say it is designed to reduce risk and comply with safety standards.
